additional_info.subject: RE: ID0387355-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / N0 160382419] Chargepoint unavailable CRM:00579001272
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
Greetings of the day!
We checked and found the following error flags:
For Mainfan error, kindly refer the following KA:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Mainfan_GQ1_Ok Signal Lost-Fan rotation disabled - Dynamics 365
For Outlet3 Unavailable, we found the following in logs:
Tue, 29 Oct 2024 17:26:45 GMT
2024-10-29, 17:26:45
2024-10-29T17:26:45.212514+00:00 sicharge-cp [local0:err] ecog-secc-adapter/78e6cbeaa1a0[712]: Error polling coap://10.20.17.101:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s
There is polling coap error multiple times.
i.e. there was loss in communication to SECC.
Till date, we are getting the same error polling coap for Outlet 3. Hence, need to check the connections to KF12 and KF13 as per the diagram below:
Kindly check the KF12 itself, whether it is getting proper supply of 24V.
Please note: Here Outlet 1 (Left) is configured as Outlet3 by CPO
Please share your observations once the above mentioned items have been checked.
We will wait for your feedback to proceed further accordingly.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
